comment: She's a very good teacher and you will learn a lot in this course, but you'll also have to put in a lot of work. I'm glad that I took her class, as my Spanish has improved a lot, but I don't know if I would put myself through the workload again.

I really enjoyed Dr. Kissling's 151 class. Her class is very engaging and interesting. She is so nice and extremely helpful in and outside of class. Dr. Kissling really wants you to improve and will go out of her way to help you. She does assign a lot of homework but each assignment really helps your spanish. I would 100% take her again.

Dr. Kissling is very kind and clearly wants her students to succeed in improving their Spanish. That said, she assigns a LOT of homework and a lot of busywork. Take this class if you truly want to get better at speaking Spanish, not just for an easy A

Professor Kissling is an amazing professor, and you will learn a lot in her class, but do not take her unless you're willing to do the work. Her exams are hard, but you are able to rewrite essays and get a lot of points back. If she sees that you have put in effort she will reward you, and she cares a lot about progress. But again, a lot of work.

She loves to assign two page papers like they're absolutely nothing and not to mention the 45$ you have to pay the weeks before finals to do the final project when you could just have as easily talked to a random person in spanish. Also enjoy those "ensayos" you spent hours writing for an average homework assignment only being worth 5 points.

Kissling is definitely a nice person and all but if you are looking for a 151 class I would look to take a different instructor. She gives 3 to 4 times the homework compared to the other instructors and the workload is much much heavier. The extra work did not really help and seemed like it was just busy work.

Overall great professor. She gives a ton of VHL homework but by completing it you can understand what is going on during class. She expects high participation from every single person in the class every day. Exams are not hard. A few pop quizzes but not worth a lot of points. She is very enthusiastic about teaching but won't baby you. I liked her.

Professor Kissling will make you work hard, but know that she is working even harder to ensure that your Spanish improves. She tailors the class to student interests and won't baby you through the course. While you might balk at the amount of homework, if you show that you're working hard, she will reward you with extra credit in the end.

Professor Kissing is incredibly passionate about everything she teaches. She does tend to have high expectations though.  Getting an A on writing assignments is not easy and you will have long readings with comprehension questions every class.  You really have to stay on top of your work because class discussions are part of your grade.

Kissling was an overall great Spanish professor. Homework is every night online and a few written exercises, too. Participation definitely matters; you will talk at least twice in every class. Quizzes are random but easy as long as you stay on top of the homework and understand it. Tests are easy if you study the guides she gives you.

As long as you complete all the homework and review daily, it's easy to get a good grade in this class. Tests weren't too difficult. The required drill sessions can get somewhat annoying. Loved her upbeat tempo and enthusiasm for teaching.

Do not take this class. She seems like a nice teacher on the first day. She gives homework everynight, assigns four long papers throughout the semester, and requires group projects with a speech consultant and writing consultant. She is very cryptic with her comments on your work, so you wont know what to correct t improve your work.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!! Unreasonable amount of homework. Back to back papers and group projects. We talked about the same thing each class. Find another FYS.

If you ever have the option, do not take her FYS (Power and Prejudice of Language). The homework regularly involves reading 20-30 page articles. The papers have extremely vague prompts and her grading is ridiculous. You have to rewrite at least two of three essays and she will give you a lower grade on the rewrite than what she gave on the original
